title: 第25章 财不露白平息风波第26章 这世道的不公宛若沉重枷锁
content_zh:
;;
就在这时，张顺不知何时走到了林青身边。
他如今已是内门弟子，气质沉稳许多。
但看向冯剑云那边的目光，也带着隐隐忌惮。
他压着声音对林青道：“林师弟，那位就是二师兄冯剑云，前段时间还去了府城考试武科，如今已经是武秀才功名。”
“以后在武馆，眼睛放亮些，尽量别得罪他。”
“这人心眼小，手段黑，背景又硬，被他盯上，麻烦不断。”
林青心中凛然。
听到这种类似泼脏水的话语。
便也知道张顺，可能在冯剑云手中吃过暗亏。
如今张顺，更似有意无意的拉拢自己，打上自己人的标签。
林青郑重的点了点头：“多谢张师兄提醒，我记下了。”
接下来时间，林青便开始继续练拳，同时和其他师兄弟一起切磋。
林青能明显感觉到，随着自己拳法技艺增强之后，其他弟子对于自己的态度，也变得热络不少。
甚至还有一些师兄，找自己询问拳法对战的要领。
“林青师弟，你的拳打得好，可不可以指点一下我？”
“我也是，林青哥，你得空教下我呗。”
“林青，有没有时间一起下馆子？”
……
……

数日时间，转瞬即逝。
夕阳如火般，将屋舍映照得红彤彤的。
林青正准备结束今日的修炼，却见一个熟悉的身影，气喘吁吁地跑进了武馆。
正是老樊家的儿子樊奎。
“青哥儿，不好了，快回去。”
“小丫，小丫家出事了！”
樊奎跑得上气不接下气，满脸焦急。
林青眼神微眯。
何小丫家出事了？
那丫头平日里对自己也好。
如今出事，自己当然不能坐视不理。
“走！”
他二话不说，拉起樊奎就往外冲，连武袍都来不及换。
两人一路狂奔回到永宁街。
还未靠近何家铁匠铺，便听见一阵哭喊和嘈杂的争吵声。

At this moment, Zhang Shun walked up to Lin Qing without knowing when.
He is now an inner disciple and has a much calmer temperament.
But the look towards Feng Jianyun was also filled with a hint of fear.
He lowered his voice and said to Lin Qing: "Junior brother Lin, that is the second senior brother Feng Jianyun. Some time ago, he went to Fucheng to take the martial arts exam, and now he has achieved the title of martial arts scholar."
"In the future, in the martial arts gym, keep your eyes open and try not to offend him."
"This man is small-minded, has dirty tricks, and has a tough background. If he is targeted, he will be in constant trouble."
Lin Qing felt awe-struck in her heart.
Hearing such words is like throwing dirty water.
He also knew that Zhang Shun might have suffered a hidden loss at the hands of Feng Jianyun.
Now Zhang Shun seems to be wooing him intentionally or unintentionally and labeling him as one of his own.
Lin Qing nodded solemnly: "Thank you, Senior Brother Zhang, for reminding me. I'll note it down."
In the following time, Lin Qing continued to practice boxing and competed with other brothers.
Lin Qing could clearly feel that as his boxing skills improved, the attitude of other disciples towards him also became much warmer.
There are even some senior brothers who ask me about the essentials of boxing combat.
"Junior brother Lin Qing, your boxing is good, can you give me some pointers?"
"Me too, Brother Lin Qing, you can teach me when you have time."
"Lin Qing, do you have time to go out to a restaurant together?"
…
…
A few days passed in a blink of an eye.
The setting sun was like fire, illuminating the house red.
Lin Qing was about to end today's training when he saw a familiar figure running into the martial arts hall panting.
It was Fan Kui, the son of the old Fan family.
"Brother Qing, it's not good, go back quickly."
"Xiaoya, something happened to Xiaoya's family!"
Fan Kui was out of breath running, his face full of anxiety.
Lin Qing's eyes narrowed slightly.
Something happened to He Xiaoya's family?
That girl is usually kind to herself.
Now that something happened, of course he couldn't just sit back and ignore it.
"Let's go!"
Without saying a word, he grabbed Fan Kui and rushed out without even having time to change his military robe.
The two of them ran all the way back to Yongning Street.
Before they even got close to the He family's blacksmith shop, they heard a burst of crying and noisy quarreling.
